manifest.scope: Special/nonfinancial Appendix G transaction meanings and documented specialized operations; excludes the separate 13-code standard financial BR package.
manifest.trainingMethod: Classify the message family first; derive one atomic BR per source-described behavior; attach all source anchors; keep unsupported prompt, response, configuration, and external-spec details REVIEW_REQUIRED.

businessRequirements.title: Special transactions shall be routed to specialized nonfinancial flows, not treated as standard financial purchases.
businessRequirements.requirement: Special transactions shall be routed to specialized nonfinancial flows, not treated as standard financial purchases.
businessRequirements.blocker: Special-flow prompt and message-family applicability must be mapped before deriving executable cases.

businessRequirements.title: Special transaction Prompt Codes shall use the three-character special-data code without appending a financial card type.
businessRequirements.requirement: Special transaction Prompt Codes shall use the three-character special-data code without appending a financial card type.
businessRequirements.blocker: The permitted code-by-code prompt behavior still needs operation-specific TS/TC/TD derivation.

businessRequirements.title: Communications Status transaction
businessRequirements.requirement: The 900 special prompt requests communications-status behavior.

businessRequirements.title: Custom receipt text
businessRequirements.requirement: The 901 special prompt retrieves custom text to print on receipts.

businessRequirements.title: Dynamic card table
businessRequirements.requirement: The 902 special prompt retrieves dynamic card-table data.

businessRequirements.title: Site configuration data
businessRequirements.requirement: The 903 special prompt submits site-configuration data.

businessRequirements.title: Host discount data
businessRequirements.requirement: The 904 special prompt retrieves host-discount data by product code for AFP transactions.

businessRequirements.title: Fuel volume data
businessRequirements.requirement: The 905 special prompt submits fuel-volume data.

businessRequirements.title: Nonproprietary electronic mail
businessRequirements.requirement: The 981 special prompt retrieves nonproprietary electronic mail.

businessRequirements.title: Totals
businessRequirements.requirement: The 990 special prompt returns totals as a single-block fixed-length response with no print data.

businessRequirements.title: Electronic mail submission
businessRequirements.requirement: The 995 special prompt submits electronic mail.

businessRequirements.title: Proprietary electronic mail
businessRequirements.requirement: The 996 special prompt retrieves proprietary electronic mail.

businessRequirements.title: Electronic mail status reset
businessRequirements.requirement: The 997 special prompt resets electronic-mail status.

businessRequirements.title: Transaction type D performs RBC Loyalty Lookup to identify the loyalty number associated with an RBC card.
businessRequirements.requirement: Transaction type D performs RBC Loyalty Lookup to identify the loyalty number associated with an RBC card.
businessRequirements.blocker: ATL105 gives the operation name and purpose only; message request/response details need an authoritative source.

businessRequirements.title: Balance Inquiry supports balance inquiry for credit, EBT cash-benefit, and stored-value contexts.
businessRequirements.requirement: Balance Inquiry supports balance inquiry for credit, EBT cash-benefit, and stored-value contexts.
businessRequirements.blocker: Per-family response and payload assertions must be derived from the corresponding sections.

businessRequirements.title: Stored-value Balance Inquiry reports the remaining balance and does not change stored-value quantity or amount totals.
businessRequirements.requirement: Stored-value Balance Inquiry reports the remaining balance and does not change stored-value quantity or amount totals.
businessRequirements.blocker: Test both returned balance and unchanged totals using an independent synthetic fixture.

businessRequirements.title: Activation activates the stored-value account for a specified dollar amount; after successful activation, charges may be made against the account.
businessRequirements.requirement: Activation activates the stored-value account for a specified dollar amount; after successful activation, charges may be made against the account.
businessRequirements.blocker: Card-product applicability and response details require separate rules where not stated here.

businessRequirements.title: For non-First-Data Standard Gift Card deactivation, the requested amount equals the account balance; after success the account may be closed according to client configuration.
businessRequirements.requirement: For non-First-Data Standard Gift Card deactivation, the requested amount equals the account balance; after success the account may be closed according to client configuration.
businessRequirements.blocker: Client account-close configuration is an external input and must not be inferred.

businessRequirements.title: For First Data Premium Gift Card cash-out, the amount is greater than zero and no more than the balance; the remaining balance becomes zero and the used amount is returned as Approved Amount.
businessRequirements.requirement: For First Data Premium Gift Card cash-out, the amount is greater than zero and no more than the balance; the remaining balance becomes zero and the used amount is returned as Approved Amount.
businessRequirements.blocker: Premium Gift Card product scope and fixture values require isolated branch coverage.

businessRequirements.title: Balance Merge combines at most two stored-value card balances onto one of those cards and reduces the remaining card balance to zero.
businessRequirements.requirement: Balance Merge combines at most two stored-value card balances onto one of those cards and reduces the remaining card balance to zero.
businessRequirements.blocker: Use two synthetic accounts and assert both destination and zeroed source balances.

businessRequirements.title: If more than two stored-value cards must be merged, repeat the merge until one card retains the combined balance.
businessRequirements.requirement: If more than two stored-value cards must be merged, repeat the merge until one card retains the combined balance.
businessRequirements.blocker: Multi-message lifecycle and intermediate balances need linked TS/TC/TD evidence.

businessRequirements.title: Replace Card transfers the balance of a lost, stolen, or damaged card to a new card with a new account number and reduces the old account balance to zero.
businessRequirements.requirement: Replace Card transfers the balance of a lost, stolen, or damaged card to a new card with a new account number and reduces the old account balance to zero.
businessRequirements.blocker: Receipt-based recovery of old account number is noted by source but operational details require a separate scenario.

businessRequirements.title: Recharge/Issue Card adds the entered amount to the current stored-value balance without exceeding the card's original value.
businessRequirements.requirement: Recharge/Issue Card adds the entered amount to the current stored-value balance without exceeding the card's original value.
businessRequirements.blocker: Derive exact boundary and reject-over-cap expected results in source-anchored TC/TD cases.

businessRequirements.title: Transaction type T identifies TransArmor token registration.
businessRequirements.requirement: Transaction type T identifies TransArmor token registration.
businessRequirements.blocker: Detailed request, response, token lifecycle, and security assertions are deferred to the external TransArmor processing specification referenced by ATL105 10.12.

businessRequirements.title: Add account
businessRequirements.requirement: Adds a new loyalty account to the loyalty host; the device captures a new card and customer street number and telephone number.

businessRequirements.title: Coupon redemption
businessRequirements.requirement: Redeems coupons for payment using loyalty account/card and Coupon ID and Coupon Amount; when the card is unavailable, street number and telephone number substitute for account number.

businessRequirements.title: Expiration date update
businessRequirements.requirement: Updates loyalty-account expiration; when the card is unavailable, street number and telephone number substitute for account number, and the host extends the account by a predefined interval.

businessRequirements.title: Account inquiry
businessRequirements.requirement: Inquires about loyalty-account status and returns merchant-maintained Loyalty Print Data; street number and telephone number may substitute when the card is unavailable.

businessRequirements.title: Points redemption
businessRequirements.requirement: Redeems a specified number of loyalty points for payment; street number and telephone number may substitute when the card is unavailable.

businessRequirements.title: Reversal of coupon redeem
businessRequirements.requirement: Reverses a previously approved coupon redemption using Coupon ID, Coupon Amount, and the prior approval number; street number and telephone number may substitute when the card is unavailable.

businessRequirements.title: Reversal of points redeemed
businessRequirements.requirement: Reverses previously approved points redemption using point amount and prior approval number; street number and telephone number may substitute when the card is unavailable.

businessRequirements.title: Sale update
businessRequirements.requirement: Updates the loyalty host with noncredit-card/cash sale amount for a loyalty account; street number and telephone number may substitute when the card is unavailable.

businessRequirements.title: Account update
businessRequirements.requirement: Updates loyalty-account street and telephone numbers; both new values are required by the described operation.

businessRequirements.title: Totals Report, Loyalty
businessRequirements.requirement: Requests a summary of loyalty transactions subtotaled by card number; the host returns the report for printing.
